==About==

Crafting {{i|Grape Cornmeal Cake}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Grape Cornmeal Cake}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Grape Cornmeal Cake. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
